method: Preselected 29 anchors reviewed against original page figures/text and M21a-accepted engine as of 2026-11-14; API assessment is not numerical execution

classification_legend.A: Existing qualified physics and suitable representation for the requested observables; authoring might still be manual
classification_legend.B: Partial existing physics; requires a small qualified reusable observer/authoring/view/analysis improvement for source-fidelity
classification_legend.C: Needs a genuinely new physical model relationship, qualified regime, or solver; partial theorems may still be true
classification_legend.D: Outside intended project regime or source too unclear to interpret

evidence_tiers.independently-exercised: Direct M21a regression compares against independent physical reference
evidence_tiers.accepted-existing-example: Previously accepted exact-source or related executable case; not reauthored or rerun for each matrix row
evidence_tiers.externally-crosschecked-exam: Printed exam provenance corroborated against independent IIT-JEE 2012 question source, but full physical behavior still unsupported
evidence_tiers.API-assessed: Read code/docs and verified source page; not an accepted end-to-end source question reproduction
evidence_tiers.figure-reviewed: Original page diagram inspected; current support assessed, not executed

limitations: Neither workbook nor curated selection is statistically representative of JEE Advanced exam frequency; 'full' refers to scoped observables and not automatic source question parsing

cases.problem_family: uniform-field work
cases.existing_route: PrescribedField/UniformElectricField: endpoint qΔV
cases.limitation: The question asks work, not elapsed-time dynamics
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: far-separated wired spheres
cases.existing_route: ConnectedShellBackend supports concentric groups only
cases.limitation: Far-apart radius-weighted floating-charge sharing requires explicit qualified separated-sphere approximation; do not model as nested
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: electron stopping near charged sheet
cases.existing_route: UniformElectricField plus TestChargeMotionSpec for field-only launch
cases.limitation: Charged metal sheet/surface normal and stopping-event presentation absent; no conductor-source substitution
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: wired solid sphere and shell released energy
cases.existing_route: MixedRadialBackend+ConnectedShellBackend; existing pdf-p03-q27 example
cases.limitation: Two static equilibria and released field energy, not time-resolved wire current or heat rate
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: grounded concentric conductors
cases.existing_route: MixedRadialBackend with Grounded/FixedNetCharge
cases.limitation: Metal thickness must be explicit; conductor interior E=0; no fake thin shell substitution
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: electron transit between voltage-biased plates
cases.existing_route: UniformElectricField+TestChargeMotionSpec for real elapsed-time constant acceleration
cases.limitation: No source-faithful plate depiction or exact plate-contact time event in prescribed motion
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: rigid dipole angle and energy
cases.existing_route: No rigid dipole orientation/torque or rotational degree of freedom
cases.limitation: Requires new qualified rigid-dipole rotation or torque observable; translating point charge is wrong
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: cavity charge and exterior potential
cases.existing_route: NestedShellBackend/analytical image charges
cases.limitation: Exterior shielding/static potential yes, not inferred charge movement
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: charge approaching grounded sphere
cases.existing_route: ExternalGroundedSphereBackend and M13b Kelvin force/induced charge sweep
cases.limitation: Current-direction and increasing-current statements require differentiating induced Q(t); stored positions are not a time waveform
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: neutral sphere tangent charge geometry
cases.existing_route: ExternalIsolatedSphereBackend; m13c/pdf_cases.py independently checks potential
cases.limitation: The tangent geometry (3-4-5) is source-given; extra radial sweep is author-added
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: stored field energy of concentric shells
cases.existing_route: MixedRadialBackend/ConnectedShellBackend field-energy computation
cases.limitation: Use all radial gap/exterior field energies, not only point-source induced interaction energy
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: connected concentric shells and heat
cases.existing_route: ConnectedShellBackend before/after and released_field_energy_j
cases.limitation: Ideal resistive heat equals static energy loss; not a discharge waveform
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: irregular conductor with two nonconcentric cavities
cases.existing_route: Gauss-law totals and shielding are reasoned analytically; no general 3D multicavity backend
cases.limitation: Cannot render correct local induced density or general cavity fields from a single concentric shell
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: two charged rings and transverse applied E: axial work
cases.existing_route: PrescribedField with two UniformRingAxisField and perpendicular UniformElectricField supports endpoint V and work
cases.limitation: Free axial trajectory in a transverse E is invalid; source work can be checked without simulating an imposed track
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: mixed separated and concentric wired shells
cases.existing_route: ConnectedShellBackend supports concentric scenes in two diagram rows
cases.limitation: Other rows have separated shells; do not apply concentric connected-shell solver to them
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: wired concentric shells change potential
cases.existing_route: ConnectedShellBackend; existing pdf-p14-q7 demonstration
cases.limitation: Two equilibria; no physical elapsed-time charge-transfer animation
cases.provenance: workbook exercise; not claimed official JEE exam

cases.problem_family: proton starts between vertical plates: 45-degree acceleration
cases.existing_route: UniformElectricField and test-charge motion support electric part
cases.limitation: Source question needs gravity simultaneously with qE; missing independent body force; not faithful electric-only motion
cases.provenance: IIT-JEE 2012 printed archive, externally corroborated

cases.problem_family: oil-drop equilibrium after switched disc field
cases.existing_route: UniformElectricField can represent idealized applied E only
cases.limitation: Gravity, switched voltage, external E and terminal-speed story require qualified multi-force/protocol; finite discs not modeled
cases.provenance: JEE Advanced 2020 printed archive, official source not independently checked

cases.problem_family: negative particle between two equal fixed point charges
cases.existing_route: Two FixedPointField providers give exact V and static turning energy
cases.limitation: Mirrored sources lie outside a chosen motion plane; current _certify checks each source separately and rejects symmetry-protected invariant motion
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: uniform fixed charge ring on symmetry axis
cases.existing_route: UniformRingAxisField and axial E/V profile; M19e oriented ring viewer
cases.limitation: Axis-only; off-axis field not implemented
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: uniform volume charge potential and field
cases.existing_route: UniformSphereField and TestChargeMotionSpec, M20c interior oscillation
cases.limitation: Volume charge is not a conducting metal sphere
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: conducting spherical shell radial V/E
cases.existing_route: NestedShellBackend and M5 field/potential viewer
cases.limitation: Static field solution; do not call static frames dynamics
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: charge inside two concentric shells
cases.existing_route: NestedShellBackend with fixed source in inner cavity
cases.limitation: Analytical/femm geometry needs strict concentric shells
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: outer shell net charge varied
cases.existing_route: NestedShellBackend repeat static equilibria
cases.limitation: Change in voltage difference must respect finite shell thickness
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: external charge near grounded conducting sphere
cases.existing_route: ExternalGroundedSphereBackend / FEMM exterior sphere; M13b force/energy sweep
cases.limitation: Induced force exact; static sweep is not real-time approach
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: two very distant thin spheres joined by wire
cases.existing_route: No qualified distinct-sphere capacitance-network connection model
cases.limitation: Far-separated limit may admit reusable Q_i proportional R_i; do not use concentric connection formulas
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: central versus displaced cavity point charge
cases.existing_route: ImageChargeShellBackend and M5 induced surface-density visualization
cases.limitation: Nonuniform inner density for displaced source; local angular structure retained
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: irregular cavity or irregular conductor exterior
cases.existing_route: Gauss-law induced total charges possible without full geometry
cases.limitation: Local surface density and irregular conductor geometry not qualified
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper

cases.problem_family: three nonconcentric cavities in one conductor
cases.existing_route: Gauss-law total inner/outer induced charge only
cases.limitation: No 3D multi-cavity local fields or surface-charge distributions
cases.provenance: teaching illustration, not an official JEE paper
